candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is uniform and clean across all views, with sharp edges and clear hardware details visible in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and downward rust runs, though the top surface dust appears slightly patchy in the top view.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a consistent, high-quality finish with clear panel lines and hardware that matches the material brief.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker shows realistic weathering with a good balance of retained paint and corrosion, particularly around the vents and edges.

grey-green_paint.observations: The base color is a consistent grey-green across all as-built views, matching the warship steel brief.

bare_hardware.observations: Handles and latches are rendered in a distinct metallic tone that contrasts with the painted body.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible along the base and edges of the as-built units, providing a grounded look.

edge_corrosion.observations: The aged state features heavy, irregular rust along the vertical edges and corners of the cabinet.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow, downward-streaking rust marks are clearly visible on the vertical faces of the aged candidate.

settled_dust.observations: A soft, light-colored overlay is present on the upward-facing surfaces of the aged units, simulating settled dust.

corroded_hardware.observations: Hardware in the aged state shows a shift toward a rusted, brownish tone compared to the clean metal of the as-built version.

findings: The dust pattern on the top surface of the aged candidate appears slightly repetitive in the top view.
The transition between the paint and the heavy rust on the vertical edges could be slightly more gradual for a more organic look.
limitations: The orthographic views limit the ability to judge the depth of the corrosion relief, and the small scale of the top view makes it difficult to assess the fine details of the dust texture.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
